answer: Harberger tax stops bulk fakes: each identity registers a jade claim on the reef ledger, sealed with a serial. Owners whisper a self-assessed value, pay 5% tax per epoch. Any peer may place a whisper bid for a jade claim at its declared price: lowballing loses it, inflating bleeds. A reused seal burns both bonds. At 200, a fake locks 70, bleeds 10 per epoch; 1,000 lock 70,000, bleed 10,000. An honest agent pays 10 per epoch, keeps its reef claim.
